description: This file defines the UsersRouter class responsible for mapping user-related HTTP routes within the application. It registers routes for creating a user action, bulk updating users, and updating a specific user.

classes.name: UsersRouter
classes.description: A router class that sets up URL route mappings for user-related actions.

methods.name: mapRoutes
methods.description: Defines and registers route mappings for user actions such as create, bulk update, and individual update.
